title: Data provenance for the AF-ΔΔG project (PHYS 7440, Assignment 9)
author: Thanh Ly

retry_policy.wait: exponential 1·2^(n-1) s (HTTP 429: 5·2^(n-1) s), cap 60 s, Retry-After honoured
retry_policy.politeness: <= 1 request per 0.25 s per host; interval doubled after HTTP 429 (max 2 s)

datasets.name: S669
datasets.citation: Pancotti C. et al. (2022) Brief. Bioinform. 23, bbab555; UniProt-mapped file from JanusDDG (Barducci et al. 2025)
transformations: downloaded from the commit-pinned raw URL and verified against SHA-256 d6e82c53c6554988bdfa0f5cf5e457b421c3bcdc279e3bbf9e5304dddf0efe51
ΔΔG unit kcal/mol -> kcal/mol (factor 1); sign checked: 76.1% of variants have ΔΔG < 0, i.e. negative = destabilising, no flip applied
IDs cleaned: mutation suffix removed ('P04517WTE2143G' -> 'P04517'); PDB-only chains get uniprot_accession = MISSING
wild type checked against the file's UniProt sequence column and against the current UniProt sequence from AlphaFold DB
pH and temperature are not in this file -> sentinel -1
joined with AlphaFold DB v6 features on (UniProt accession, UniProt position)
669 rows written to data/processed/variants_ly.parquet

datasets.name: S2648
datasets.citation: Dehouck Y. et al. (2009) Bioinformatics 25, 2537 (protddg-bench release)
transformations: downloaded from the commit-pinned raw URL and verified against SHA-256 e708b274574b02d8cc0b39efc0f09b6180ae211c714306ec05c685c86b55766c
ΔΔG unit kcal/mol -> kcal/mol (factor 1); sign checked: 77.3% of variants have ΔΔG < 0, i.e. negative = destabilising, no flip applied
temperature converted from °C to K (+273.15)
PDB author numbering mapped to UniProt numbering with PDBe SIFTS segments, validated against the UniProt sequence, with a chain-wide offset vote as fallback (column numbering_map)
joined with AlphaFold DB v6 features on (UniProt accession, UniProt position)
2648 rows written to data/processed/variants_ly.parquet

datasets.name: PDBe SIFTS mappings
datasets.role: identifier normalisation of S2648 (PDB chain -> UniProt accession and numbering)
datasets.version: SIFTS through the live PDBe API (no release number exposed); fingerprinted by responses_sha256
transformations: chain selected by author chain ID (fallback: label asym ID)
segment offset unp_start - author_start applied to the author residue number
wild type validated against the UniProt sequence; chain-wide offset vote when >= 3 sites and >= 80% agree
insertion-code residues left unmapped (sentinel)

datasets.name: AlphaFold DB prediction API
datasets.role: model metadata and reference UniProt sequence
datasets.version: AlphaFold DB; model versions seen: 1, 6; files pinned to v6
transformations: record chosen as in Assignment 7: exact accession, GDM provider, F1 fragment, monomer, newest version
uniprotSequence used to validate residue numbering

datasets.name: AlphaFold DB confidence (pLDDT) files
transformations: pLDDT at the site (2 dp)
mean pLDDT over ±5 residues (3 dp)

datasets.name: AlphaFold DB model coordinates (PDB)
transformations: contact number: Cβ (Cα for Gly) atoms within 10 Å of the site's Cβ

datasets.name: AlphaMissense tables (AlphaFold DB)
datasets.version: AlphaMissense (Cheng et al. 2023, Science 381, eadg7492) as served by AlphaFold DB; no version number exposed
transformations: pathogenicity of the exact substitution
class codes LBen/Amb/LPath -> likely_benign/ambiguous/likely_pathogenic
mean of the 19 substitutions at the site

datasets.name: UniProt REST (FASTA)
datasets.role: fallback reference sequence when AlphaFold DB has no model
datasets.version: UniProtKB release current at the access time
transformations: first FASTA record, used only to validate numbering

variants.content_hash_definition: SHA-256 of df[schema columns].to_csv(index=False, float_format='%.10g', lineterminator='\n', na_rep='NaN'); rows: S669 then S2648, each in source order

source_row.description: 0-based row number in the source file

source_id.description: identifier as written in the source (S669 ID column; S2648 PDB_CHAIN)

source_mutation.description: mutation as written in the source, in source numbering

group.description: clustering key: S669 protein, S2648 sequence cluster CLID

protein.description: protein key: cleaned S669 ID, or S2648 PDB_CHAIN

mutation_uniprot.description: mutation in UniProt numbering, e.g. S11A

numbering_map.description: how the UniProt position was obtained (status column, never a sentinel)

wt_check.description: wild type vs reference sequence: match / mismatch / unverified (status column)

af_model_version.description: AlphaFold DB model version (latestVersion of the entry)

af_model_created.description: modelCreatedDate of the AlphaFold DB entry

plddt.description: AlphaFold per-residue confidence at the site

burial_cn10.description: Cβ atoms (Cα for Gly) within 10 Å of the site's Cβ in the AF model

am_pathogenicity.description: AlphaMissense pathogenicity of this exact substitution

am_position_mean.description: mean AlphaMissense score of the 19 substitutions at the site

missing_fields.description: ';'-separated list of fields replaced by sentinels ('' if none)

sentinels.why: -1 is used only for fields whose real values are never negative (pLDDT 0-100, AlphaMissense 0-1, contact counts >= 0, residue numbers >= 1, pH >= 0, T > 0 K), so it cannot be mistaken for data. ΔΔG uses NaN because -1 kcal/mol is a real ΔΔG. Every substituted field is also listed in the row's 'missing_fields' column and in data/processed/missing_fields_ly.csv with its source URL.

reproducibility.how_to_check: python data_pipeline_ly.py --fresh (re-downloads everything and compares with the content hash recorded before), then python data_pipeline_ly.py --verify
